description: Calculates verified busy jobs and open planning windows for a local business day without scheduling or changing a job. Use to find scheduling availability in the connected business. Returns date, timezone, planning_window, duration_minutes, job_duration_minutes, busy, available_slots, scope.

date.description: Local business date, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today.

name: schedule-availability

available_slots.description: Bounded available slots records returned by this tool.

busy.description: Bounded busy records returned by this tool.

date.description: Date used or returned by this tool.

duration_minutes.description: Duration minutes for the returned result.

job_duration_minutes.description: Job duration minutes for the returned result.

planning_window.description: Planning window metadata; empty collections retain their existing JSON array representation.

scope.description: Authorization scope of this result; data remains restricted to the connected business.

timezone.description: Timezone used or returned by this tool.

title: Schedule Availability Tool
